dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: If not for those Blubberbeasts, I should have been able to hook the larger fish... *sigh*

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Oh, Traveler! Pleased to see you here, most pleased! Are you here to fish, too?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Hmm... It seems you're just passing through. It's alright. This fishing point has got fish for two and then some, so if you don't mind, come, sit and fish with me.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Tell me about Iaune...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Iaune? He should be in the Maison Gestion writing that report of his. Don't worry, he'll be fine.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: I wasn't lying before, either. This is indeed a good opportunity for him. Not everyone has the chance to submit written documents to the Chief Justice on their own.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, he's really submitting reports to *the* Chief Justice?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It was just a matter of one keycap. How did it get this serious...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Yes, it was indeed only one keycap, but that was not the end of the matter... It is a "financial issue," if one were to use the high-flown term for it.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is that... very serious?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But a keycap doesn't even cost that much. Iaune could've just gotten one with his own Mora...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: This problem is very serious. From your perspective, a single keycap costs very little, and would mean little if submitted as expenses or paid for yourself.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: But if you look at it from our perspective, this represents an "exception" to the rules the Maison Gestion operates by.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Yes, you could say that a single keycap matters very little, but if someone were to try to profit off this "exception," then, we would be in trouble.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: As to "what sort of trouble might occur"... I'll have to tell you later. In any case, there is something I need your help with at the moment.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Well, now, I couldn't possibly tell you such a long story willy-nilly. I'm on break right now!

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Hehe, alright, I was joking. I just needed a moment to organize my thoughts and find a simple example to illustrate my point.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Please help me chase those Blubberbeasts away for now. Thank you!

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: They are as interminably persistent as journalists. They've been crowding about this school of fish and simply refused to leave.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: I'd love to chase them away, but I lack the skills, so I'll have to trouble you to help me out.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright then...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And you go think your story over!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If the story isn't good, we're gonna call those Blubberbeasts right back!

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Hahaha, alright, alright. I'm sure they would be happy to be given such marching orders...

choices.text: Don't cut your story off halfway!

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: This bait's running out so quickly. What's going on...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You've come a long way for some fish.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Ah, so we meet here, I see. What a coincidence!

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Anyway, that's just how fishing is, we've gotta follow the fish. Carrying your gear and tramping about with your fishing buddies is quite the unique pleasure as well, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But you've gone such a long distance... What if your fishing gear breaks?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: You're right, and that's something I'm concerned about at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So your gear did break!

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Oh, it happens. I've already fixed it, anyway. The only problem is that I've been unable to find suitable bait.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, couldn't you just dig up a few worms and use them?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: No, that wouldn't do. Those fish are a picky lot. They're not going to go for worms previously held in human hands.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: But we can't make any other sort of bait here...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Traveler, could I trouble you to go into the city and get me some bait?

choices.text: That came rather naturally to you, eh?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Hahaha, don't worry, I'll pay you, as is the rule for adventurers.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: I paid Boucicaut a bit of a sum beforehand. Just grab a box of bait from him on my behalf, and that'll do.

choices.text: My arrival truly is a fortunate coincidence.

dialogues.speaker: Boucicaut
dialogues.text: Hello. What may I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Roialte would like some bait...

dialogues.speaker: Boucicaut
dialogues.text: Seriously? Fishing in the wilderness again, is he? Archons, and I keep telling him that it isn't safe...

dialogues.speaker: Boucicaut
dialogues.text: If anything were to happen, no one would even be there to hear him scream. But he just won't listen to me...

dialogues.speaker: Boucicaut
dialogues.text: He'll probably only listen after something happens, I fear.

dialogues.speaker: Boucicaut
dialogues.text: Anyway, here's the bait. Take it to Roialte — and remind him to stay safe while you're at it.

dialogues.speaker: Boucicaut
dialogues.text: Seriously, would it really hurt him to call a few people to join him for a fishing session?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Those silly Blubberbeasts have been chased off — and with that, my peace of mind is restored! Thank you so much, Traveler.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Alright, alright. Now, where was I previously... Give me a moment to recall the story...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You were talking about "exceptions."

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Ah, yes, that was it. I was talking about making a profit off exceptional circumstances...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: For example, someone might be able to scrub the various resources they have on hand, and then report them as expenses... or try to expand the scope of this particular "exception"... These are all things that can happen.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And have such things happened?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Before Iaune was with us, we had another clever fellow. He was very able, very clever, sharp, and full of energy.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: ...Unfortunately, he was not honest.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Eventually, he was booted from the office, and I haven't seen him since... nor do I wish to, really.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did he do something terrible, then?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: He certainly did not think that about his doings — and that is precisely the kind of mindset that gives birth to criminality.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: That's why I have high expectations for Iaune. He's not the sharpest tool in the shed, but he's honest and diligent.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That doesn't sound like praise...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: But honesty is the greatest virtue. A dishonest but intelligent person may achieve great fame in a short period of time...

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: But it is often those stupid yet honest people who will accomplish truly great things.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Alright, I'm going to continue fishing now. Please, take this as your payment. Hahaha, don't look so surprised. Did you really think I was just going to pay you with a story?

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: All those who labor must be compensated — that's always been my motto.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Thank you once again. I'm sure I'll score a great catch this time.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: *sigh* These silly Blubberbeasts just won't leave, will they...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Fishing again?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Well, what does it look like I'm doing? I just chased off a few of those unreasonable journalists, so I'm just taking a little fishing break.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: But these Blubberbeasts just won't leave, and I daren't approach them... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Honestly! Did they learn their trade from those journalists? And did they master those dastardly arts of opportunistic deception?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You really do hate journalists, huh.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Of course. Some of them raise a hue and cry about reporting the truth, but truth, as they see it, is for them to define.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: They claim to be doing this for the masses, but they don't even know about this...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Hmm, I should stay silent. You never know if there might be a journalist in a divesuit eavesdropping on us from under water.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Traveler, could I trouble you to get rid of those Blubberbeasts? Just thinking about journalists is making my head spin... I need to take my medicine and rest a while more, I think.

response.speaker: Roialte
response.text: Thank you. I'm afraid I'll have to find another good place to fish...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Have you gotten rid of those silly Blubberbeasts? Wonderful! You truly are my savior!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you been well lately?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Not bad, not bad, I suppose. Iaune has gone back to his normal self at last, and Semaine's as reliable as ever.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Every day is as peaceful as the last. It's a good life... And it would be better if those journalists would just stop calling at our door.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Please take this as your payment. If not for you, my fishing plans would have been a bust.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: I need to pick another fishing spot. Where should I go...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: I need to strengthen this rod further...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: The weather's good, the fishing spot's great, no Blubberbeasts, and no journalists... Ah, this is the life!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: In a good mood today, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: In various ways, yes, and now that you're here, I've never been better, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did something good happen? Or something interesting, maybe?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: No, no, in fact, everything's as peaceful as placid waters!

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: No journalists, no announcements, no leaks, and no lost forms or documents.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Everything is operating as it should without any mistakes...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... Don't move! Whatever you do, don't move!

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: What? Why so sudden...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just freeze...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: What happened? Did those Blubberbeasts come back? Haha, I looked all around, you know. They...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Agh! Slimes!? Where did they all pop out from? Help! Help!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, that's why we told you not to move about!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Get down!

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Help me, please!

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: I take back what I said before. It seems that not everything is going to plan today...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Those Slimes were just going about their day.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Funny, aren't you? I envy your good humor... Following your logic, I suppose that today was, in fact, the Slimes' lucky day, and I was just a bit actor in their play?

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: It seems that everyone's definition of a "good day" need not be the same, nor must they be in conflict with one another.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Ugh... I think I injured my waist during the kerfuffle earlier. I need to get it checked in the city soon... Ow, ow...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Here's your payment, Traveler. I... Ow, ow... Ugh, that really hurts.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Have you brought the bait back? Wonderful! Time to continue fishing, I say.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Boucicaut wants to relay this message...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You pass Boucicaut's words onto Roialte...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Hahaha, is he worried about me? It's fine, I know what I'm doing.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: As for inviting my old fishing buddies... Some of them have settled down with family, while others are busy with work. Either way, we haven't been in touch for a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: And I'm not the type to go fishing with strangers, so rather than do that, I'd prefer to go it alone.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Hmm, now that you mention it... I could call Iaune to come fishing with me. He could use the break, in any case.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Anyway, Traveler, here's your payment. Thanks for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Yes, this sounds good. I'll go fish for Iaune's opinion tomorrow at work.

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: If he's willing to come, we'll be able to bring more gear, go further, and find some better fishing spots...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Hmm, what should I say next...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: *sigh* These silly Blubberbeasts just won't leave, will they...

dialogues.speaker: Roialte
dialogues.text: Agh! Slimes!? Where did they all pop out from?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come on, can't you see we're listening to a story here? Shoo!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This'll do. Let's go back to Roialte and see what sort of story he'll spin.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This should do it! Let's head back and look for Roialte.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gah, where did these Hydro Slimes come from? Stop 'em!
